newsitem.title: USA: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 110.0 in March.
newsitem.headline: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 110.0 in March.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 110.0 in March from a revised 108.0 reading in the prior month, ECRI said.
"The FIG was up two points in March, the largest monthly increase since August 1994, and points to a sharp rise in inflation pressures," ECRI said.
The gauge was bolstered by faster growth in civilian employment and real estate loans, ECRI said.
"Six out of eight components of the gauge show greater inflationary pressures than they did six months ago," it said.
